description:
New Features

  • Fence Display: Added height and RAKED labels to panels.
  • Product SKUs: Added full catalogue view with a missing-SKU filter.
  • Product SKUs: Added Bulk Save.

Improvements

  • Fence Display: Aligned glass pool raked spigots across panel sizes.
  • Fence Display: Rebuilt flat top raked panels to match glass pool scaling and alignment.
  • Fence Display: Updated Load Quote hint to point to Project Plan & Cart.
  • Admin Controls: Replaced gear icons with labelled dark buttons across admin pages.
  • Admin Controls: Rebuilt menus with consistent icons, labels, and descriptions.
  • Product SKUs: Renamed Missing SKUs and moved it to a cleaner URL with redirect.
  • Product SKUs: Deep Scan now sends results directly to Fill.
  • Product SKUs: Sequenced saves to prevent edits being lost during simultaneous saves.

Fixes

  • Fence Display: Fixed flat top and glass pool panel displays.
  • Admin Controls: Fixed Group Permissions menu icon labels.
  • Product SKUs: Fixed row selection scrolling away from the current item.
  • Product SKUs: Fixed empty results when filtering filled rows.

Testing

  • Fence Display: Verified all step-ups from 1300 to 1800.

Product and Admin Updates

New Features

  • Added a loading animation when saving.
  • Product SKUs: Added featured image and product description.

Improvements

  • Updated toast notifications to show only one popup for the same message at a time.
  • Updated Edit Product to copy the product HTML.
  • Product SKUs: Changed saving to one product at a time to prevent multiple simultaneous edits.
  • Updated Store Products to allow product descriptions to be displayed.
  • Updated Admin Settings toggle buttons with improved UI/UX.

Fixes

  • Fixed the Close CRM data formatting error on Zapier.

New Features

  • Added an SEO tab to Settings:
    • Visibility, health check, search appearance with live preview, indexing, social sharing, structured data, verification.
    • Title, meta, robots and structured data on every public page.
    • Local, staging and demo stay noindex.
  • Added a Site Health tab to Settings:
    • Super Admin only, read only.
    • Server, database and security checks with a score and a copyable report.

Improvements

  • Restored the Step 1 loading skeleton on the planner. Steps 2 and 3 now wait for it.
  • Updated the Settings page layout:
    • Card headers match, section lines run edge to edge, Branding form and Live Preview rebuilt as cards.

New Features

  • Added per site Cloudflare cache purging with setup and zone validation.
  • Added a Developer page for managing CSS/JS minification with toggles, rebuild, sorting, and status overview.
  • Added the same sticky overview to Site Health and SEO pages.
  • Added lazy loading for Project Plan and cart product images.

Improvements

  • Updated Settings and Fence Styles with a modern vertical sidebar and UI polish.
  • Simplified the Integration Sites table and removed purge confirmation.

Fixes

  • Fixed older browser compatibility for minified files.
  • Fixed missing fonts on the live fencesperth.com planner caused by Cloudflare font optimisation.

Testing

  • Tested minified CSS/JS across planner, project plans, product lookup, and admin with no design or logic changes.

New Features

  • Added Ctrl + Click on Product SKUs to copy a value across the row.
  • Added Website, Planner, Backend, Cloudflare Verify, and Purge actions to the Sites menu.

Improvements

  • Updated the slat spacer across all fencing calculators.
  • Improved Minify page with collapsible file tables and saved toggle state.
  • Standardised admin buttons, tabs, pagination, dialogs, and action menus using reusable Bootstrap classes.
  • Removed button shadows, thick bottom borders, and unnecessary one off CSS.
  • Updated hover styling across admin pages and moved "Open Planner" into the Actions menu.

Fixes

  • Fixed the desktop page title mobile menu button.

Testing

  • Tested changes in a safe local copy, including Super Admin/non-Super Admin, mobile widths, and browser scans.

New Features

  • Added a Super Admin only PHP Info tab with sensitive values hidden.

Improvements

  • Polished the admin UI and improved button, filter, and tab layouts.
  • Updated the Product SKUs image viewer and added product details.
  • Improved error monitoring for admin and planner logs, including download and clear options.

Fixes

  • Resolved all Site Health warnings on the live Perth site.
  • Fixed a live admin outage and added safeguards against future PHP setting issues.
  • Fixed the Site Health scrolling issue and improved Media Library upload errors.

Improvements

  • Redrew all six Step 1 cards with consistent sizing and spacing.
  • Adjusted Barr and Flat Top posts to finish level with the panel tops.
  • Updated the latch designs for Flat Top and Barr.

Testing

  • Verified Flat Top and Barr latches at 1000, 1200, and 1800mm heights.

Premium Perforated Pool Fencing Planner

  • Fixed wafer screws for Monument jobs.

Testing

  • Ran a full side by side test of the new planner against the original.
  • Checked all new planner orders on the store cart page.
  • Documented missing and incorrect items in the original planner.

Testing

Slat Fencing with Gates

New Features

  • Added heavy-duty rails and post fields to slat fencing with gates, aligned with the gates flow.

  • Synced gate count with the calculator for accurate quantities.

Fixes

  • Fixed the gate handle SKU to use the correct supplied item.

  • Extracted the required product SKUs from WooCommerce products.
  • Cleaned product text on display and save:

    • Applies to PRODUCT / PRODUCT NAME / DESCRIPTION.
  • Updated the product CSV import to auto-create products.csv with a header if missing.

    • products-infill.csv.
    • products-slat-gate.csv.
